reviews.text: I love this vet, they are so good to my dog Django.

I would fly across the world for the vets at Holt!  They care about both owners and pet, they aren’t about doing unnecessary tests and they do not sugar coat anything.  Nothing but complete honesty from everyone employed at Holt.  They will always be my number one choice for vet services.  Thank you for all you do!
I have always had good care for my pets at Holt and the staff is great!
Very nice folks and good car for my dog
Holt Veterinary is the best!  The only place I go.
Great staff, very friendly and wonderful with our pups.
We always love coming to Holt.  We do not have to make an appointment we never have to wait.  The vets and staff are all excellent

A good friend and long time customer of Holt recommended them. I saw Dr. Geoffrey Bratton at Holt Veterinary Clinic for the first time this week for a minor matter with one of my dogs. I was so pleased. Dr. Bratton took time with me and Lily to listen and explain what I needed to know.
He was very knowledgeable, personable and kind to my dog. The Holt  veterinary practice is small and does not have a lot of people waiting to be served, even though Holt does not take appointments during the week. After several bad experiences with a larger hospital open 24 hours, Holt's staff and facility were refreshing. Smaller is better in this case. I wish I had switched a long time ago. I lost a cherished dog this week who might still be alive if I had chosen Holt as my vet service. Thank you.
Thoughtful and kind attention as is always shown to my best buddy Robbie, Gordon Setter. He was seen for his annual and vaccinations and is always a happy pup at Holt's Veterinary Clinic.
Dr. Kiefer is the best.  Teddy starts wagging his tail as soon as I mention her name.
The compassion and care they gave to me and my animal, it was my worst day.  I will forever use this clinic.
Amazingly friendly and compassionate staff! Building was very clean and nice as well

First time here with our recent Great Pyrenees rescue pup. Everyone was super nice and helpful especially in getting a nervous pup in and out of the room and getting checked out. Dr Thomas was so sweet and we look forward to continuing care here.

I always feel heard and our dog always feels better after visiting Holt Veterinary Clinic! They go above and beyond to make sure you understand their recommendations and that you are comfortable with them. The entire staff is welcoming and professional. We love Holt!
Holt is the best vet with the best staff. Dr Bratton listens and takes time to help you through whatever is going on with your pet. I trust them with my dog’s care completely.
Everyone from vets to techs to office admins are just so helpful and kind.
My little tiny 9 wk old ShihTzu was handled very gently. Got a shot and checked for everything else and he didn’t cry one time. Thrilled! Plus Holt takes walk ins!
I just changed from another vet to Holt. I love that you don't need an appointment. They accommodate my sometimes reactive dog, pricing is very fair, and the staff is amazing!

Very professional , knowledgeable and caring service by the veterinarian and the staff at the clinic for my 7 month old golden retriever. The wait to see the veterinarian was short, and my puppy improved dramatically within only 24 hours after tests were completed and prescriptions started . Thank you again for getting my young dog back on her feet.
First time here today and had a great experience. It was quick and staff was friendly. Prices were affordable.
Worked us in very timely! Wonderful doctors as well as fast and efficient. Most of all they were spot on with our issue.

The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and knowledgeable. They took great care of my kitten and made sure they were happy, healthy, and comfortable throughout the visit. I truly appreciated their kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!

Since relocating to Dallas almost 6 years ago I have not found a vet that I really loved until Dr. Bratton!  I was so pleased with our visit this past weekend - he was so personable, amazing with my babies, communicative, and paid extra attention to detail.  This was my second visit with Holt, and both have been great experiences.  The office is so nice and appointments move along seamlessly.  I would absolutely recommend this office and specifically Dr. Bratton!
Fast efficient and very knowledgeable!  Wish I had gone to them years ago!
Caring, professional, experienced care - very impressive!
Yall did awesome, thank you for being kind & gentle with rottie!

Dr. Watkins was amazing with my sick baby. I was seen both days VERY quickly. Dr. Watkins was kind, extremely thorough and explained everything in detail. She also tried to save me unnecessary expenses, which I truly appreciated. Highly recommend, I will be back!

This clinic is beyond amazing. Dr. Kiefer and really all the staff and other drs are so kind and caring. Started bringing my senior dog here late last year and I cannot say enough good things about the care he received. We sadly had to say goodbye to Chaz recently, and they made a very hard day manageable. There was no sterile medical room, but instead a room that felt comfortable and safe. The staff had always been kind and caring but that day I felt it even more. Thank you so much!

Wonderful veterinarian, Dr. Bader (?)  - really thoughtful, direct, addressed issues I had forgotten to bring up initially, suggested options for treatment and didn't try to create an astronomical treatment plan. Honestly, so impressed.
Holt has been our vet for many years. Always take great of our dogs
Helped me get my USDA international pet import permit to travel with my service dog. Outstanding customer service.

I just moved to Dallas and was dealing with a sick pooch. I’m not working yet so I couldn’t afford to pay emergency vet fees. I was pleasantly surprised to learn about Holt and the walk in clinic. They got us in so quickly and treated us so well. And the cost was very affordable. I just found our regular vet.

They are caring & have cared compassionately for our cat Toby & our dog Honey - their level of care is excellent- it is easy to get in as you do not need an appointment Monday- Friday thank you Dr Bratton & all the caring staff!!

Efficient check-in, Cosmo was brought in for an ear ache, turned out he had a yeast infection.  He was treated and is feeling better.  Sophie W. Was very caring and loving to Cosmo as he was taken back for treatment.  Thank you.

Best vet clinic I’ve ever found! Always available for fast, caring services!
They’re terrific!

Dr. Harden was outstanding as she treated our sweet Riley with care and expertise we have come to rely on at Holt. Reception was also wonderful getting us in to see the doctor and on our way home without further stress. We appreciate the entire team. Thank you!
Love Holt vet and their whole team. Have been taking our boys here for nearly 8 years and feel very cared for.

I recently visited Holt Veterinary Clinic for the first time with my senior cat for vaccines and a yearly wellness exam, and I couldn’t be more impressed by this clinic. The staff were kind, welcoming, and attentive.

We saw Dr. Geoff Bratton, who was excellent. He was thorough in his examination, took the time to answer all of my questions, and explained everything clearly. What stood out most was his conservative approach. He advocated for my cat’s health and prioritized what was genuinely necessary rather than recommending anything excessive.

Dr. Bratton came across as highly knowledgeable and articulate. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I feel confident bringing my cat back for future care.
Needed the periodic treatment for an aging cat.  All went well and the car is doing much better.

I brought in my beloved cat Mr. Big for the first time. He was seen promptly and the vet who saw him was kind, knowledgeable, gave him an effective treatment for his inflamed gums along with follow up advice. This is our 4th visit to Holt, have seen 3 different vets and I have been pleased and impressed every time.
The people at Holt are personable and seem to truly care about my pup. I appreciate Holt personnel, especially Dr. Kiefer, very much!! Dr. Kiefer and her vet tech were terrific with Daisy!!
Love Holt Vet !!  They are the best!!
the staff and all the vets are amazing

Love the option to walk in. So convenient when you have a kitty and the time it takes to get them in a carrier can vary each time. The vet tech was so sweet and gentle handling my baby. Dr. Bratton has been the best! He puts me at ease during the difficult visits of not knowing what’s wrong with my baby. He’s really patient and great at explaining everything and he uses safe practicing. I learn so much at these visits and I know my babies will be well taken care of!
Always willing to help us! Great service and they love our puppy!!!!
Love everything about it. Would never consider going anywhere else!

Our dog was 911-dying due to bloat.  I called HOLT telling them I was coming w/her and to get ready.  They said, "we are already OUTSIDE." Gut wrenching situation w/Dr. Kiefer and her staff.  They were capable and compassionate.  Everyone cared and did their best to make the worst moment-honorable for our beloved furbaby-Storm. Forever indebted to HOLT VET CLINIC.  Highly recommend and trust them implicitly.
Nice place. Great location. Everything went smoothly.

First time taking my dog to the vet he was so anxious and they were quick, knowledgeable, polite, and did such a good job at calming him down!!! I wish I got everyone’s name, but please take your dog here! You can trust he/she will be in the right hands :)
I been going to Holt for 25+ years for all my (4) pet’s medical and boarding needs. Couldn’t recommend more highly.
The best!
Amazing team !
Terrific, trusting, and timely patient care and service!
If you want a trustworthy Veterinarian with an awesome staff, Holt’s is the best place for your pet care.
I love this clinic. Everyone is so kind and professional. The doctors really genuinely care. They treat my animals like they truly love them.

Holt Veterinary Clinic is hands down the best. All of the staff: the front desk staff, the techs, the doctors, are very passionate about their job, companionate about the animals, and understanding of people that bring in their animals. Dr. Casey Kiefer is very an intelligent experienced vet. You can tell she cares about the pet and will direct you down a path in the best way to remedy a problem concerning your aninal.
Holt Veterinary Clinic is wonderful!
The vets and techs are sympathetic. They will get down on the ground to care for my wiener dog when she doesn’t want to be lifted.
Very helpful! Easy to make an appointment or walk in  and very nice people who truly care about my pets! Easily would recommend to anyone in the surrounding area!

Have been with Holt for decades. Staff is always so cordial and helpful. Shay, Pablo, are standouts. The only reason for the 4 stars is because of the new practice of taking the dog back for all treatment. Very little time with vet, only vet techs. Kind of impersonal but perhaps I’ve been a client so long therefore slow to adapt to new practices.
We had a very sick senior cat. They took time to explain all of her issues and a plan for care. Prices seem reasonable relative to other corporate owned chains.
Holt is wonderful.

Dr. Kiefer is the best! Our Boston Terrier ate pieces of a garden hose and she operated and removed the objects from her stomach and intestines. Dr Kiefer was so supportive and helpful to us and our girl, Scout. Love Holt!!❤️
Very friendly and compassionate staff. My new puppy felt right at home!!!
I tell everyone I know, and even don’t know, how excellent Holt is!!! The level of care is incredible. The fact that I don’t have to have an appointment is a huge convenience!
dogs were clean and happy

2 cats for annual checkup and shots - took longer than I anticipated for the doctor to arrive and there were very few patients other than us. Doctor was very good and efficient once she arrived. However because of the cost, I will have to start looking at alternative care for my cats. I hate to do it, because I have always liked Holt Clinic and have taken my pets there for many years, but I have to watch my spending.

My veterinarian who I used for the past 40 years closed her practice so I was left without Veterinary care until I found Holt Clinic. They have seen several of my personal pets as well as fosters I have and they go above and beyond.  Everyone thereis so nice.
Always the best and so attentive.
Holt is my go to and always will be. Incredibly friendly and professional staff. Wait staff is great. Rooms and waiting area are always spotless.

We love the office and drive past countless others to bring our dog to Holt !! Feels family run and local with people that care truly about our pet and animals. We will never use any other Vet in Dallas !! And we have been to a handful, with pitiable experiences . Thank you Holt Vet ❤️
Holt Vet is absolutely the best place!  My pets have always been cared for with kindness and expertise.  Their staff is so attentive and helpful.

The veterinarians and staff at Holt Veterinary Clinic are wonderful and provided great care to my anxious mini Aussie when we went in for an annual wellness exam. They took time to listen and address any concerns, and they made the “traumatic” (aka dramatic) vet experience less so by calming my little one. Thank you for the great care!
Wonderful veterinary clinic with seasoned  professional, veterinarians and staff. I highly recommend them.
Great prompt care! Will be back!
Dr. Bratton is always thorough, friendly and reasonable !
Holt took very good care of Fred.  I would recommend them to my friends or anyone else reading this.
The staff is so nice, helpful and friendly.
Friendly, efficient, good communication, fair pricing and most importantly, excellent care of our fur babies!

My Luca was in a lot of distress from breaking into the trash and eating bones.  We were afraid he had a splinter so went for an x-ray.  The visit was much easier than I anticipated (given it was our first visit), and the x-ray was clean. They let me look for myself at the x-ray, and I loved that.  Everyone was super nice and professional.

I have been taking my dogs to Holt Veterinary Clinic for twenty years. My prior dog Mister went to Holt for six years until he died. This is a pic of my boy Vinny. He is a very healthy 14 year-old and Holt has been caring for him since he was a puppy. The entire staff is very helpful and friendly.

Wow. Consistently the best. I have always had the best experiences with my dog. I took a foster cat after they weren't getting sensible care at their fancy vet. Dr Bratton and his staff immediately took great care of the medical condition and I felt great relief. Always the best. So personable and effective.
Great experience for first time visit with my new puppy.
Always great care for my two labs. The Dr and techs are wonderful.

Dr. Bratton was absolutely amazing! He was incredibly educational, offering helpful tips and treating our puppy with so much care. We left feeling safe, informed, and confident. After doing extensive research and visiting a few vets in the DFW area, I can confidently say Holt is the one I’d recommend. They truly go above and beyond!
I brought a new kitten in for initial check and vaccines. Dr. Watkins and the staff are amazing. I truly love Holt Vet Clinic.
The staff is so friendly and takes good care of my wild pug, Henry VIII
Our cat acted like a total jack-hole. Dr. Bratton's staff handled him beautifully.

This is the best Vetinarian clinic we have been to in Dallas.  Have been going for years and was recommended by a friend and client of Holt’s.  I’m comfortable they will not over treat our dogs.  Towards the last year of one of our old pups, I was in there several times a week for subcutaneous fluid administration free of charge.  We will continue to take our animals here so long as they maintain the same wonderful staff and doctors!

Oh yes… And they don’t take appointments except for Saturdays, so you just walk in. I would say my average wait is about 10 minutes, with exception of just a few times when it was totally jammed.
We love Holt Clinic! They have taken excellent care 4 dogs of ours over many years.

Started going there with my 1st dog in the mid 50's. Started again a few years ago. You saved my dog's life at least twice. I love that it is walk in. When there were emergencies, you acted immediately.  I recommend you all the time.
Great experience. Best vet in dallas.
Great care and took lots of time with me explaining options and recommendations.  Reasonably priced too. Recommend to all!
Friendly caring always helpful and Shea is the best
Had a great experience with Holt Vet. The CC clinic is good for all of Maya’s needs.
Our cat was boarded 2 weeks and the staff took such good care of her.
Small intimate environment. Love my vet, fully confident in Dr. Bratton.
Been at this vet for 45 years! Love the staff over all the years.
Came in for dog's skin issues. Saw a vet quickly, and he was very thorough, and explained everything to me as we went along.
I can’t ask for anything better.I thank the entire staff for being as good as you are from every aspect.
I appreciate the caring attitude of everyone who works at Holt Vet Clinic.  I know that Lucy is in great hands when I take her there

Dr. Watkins is everything you'd hope for in a veterinarian—compassionate, thorough, and incredibly knowledgeable. She has cared for my diabetic cat, Ramona, with such empathy and precision, and I always leave our appointments feeling informed and reassured. Her genuine love for animals is evident in every interaction, and I’m grateful for the care and respect she gives to both of us.
Holt has provided the best care for all my dogs. It’s a wonderful practice with experienced caring vets.Ive been using them for years and won’t go anyplace else.
Best vet in Dallas and it’s not even close.
Everyone is so kind and helpful. I love the clinic. Dr. Bratton and his staff are the BEST!!  Pablo makes it all so easy. Thanks D
everyone is so friendly and helpful at the clinic
Dr Kiefer, techs and staff are fabulous
Great service and friendly and professional staff😊 …

Each staff member we interacted with around the neutering surgeries of our two puppies was extremely helpful, from the receptionists to the veterinarian herself.  They listened to our concerns and resolved them quickly, and made suggestions that resolved issues we weren’t aware of.  Highly recommend!
Check out needs new automation - always takes too long but all staff are friendly at desk as are the dog handlers
Love ❤️ you guys keep up the awsome!! Work with our fur babies 🐕 im Nippsey and I love Holt Vetinary.. …

Dr. Kiefer and all of the staff and veterinarians care about Teddy and Bear. While we have been navigating Bear’s illness, Drs. Kiefer and Britton have always provided us with the time, information and context we need to make informed health decisions for him. The reception staff and techs have always been gentle and kind with our boys.

Great vets and treat your dogs with patience and kindness and treat the owners the same way. Everything is explained in a way that I can understand.  My doggies are very important to me and the vets there act like the doggies are important to them.  They like animals and people too.
The staff was very nice and reassuring about my pets. The wait was short, the place was clean. I’m glad I found this vet!
Staff is courteous. Always get taken care of quickly. Pablo is the best!

Holt has always gone above and beyond for us and our pets! The staff is always so friendly and kind. We love them and definitely would recommend to anyone looking for an amazing vet in the Dallas area!!!
My big dog and I love Holt!

I absolutely love Holt! We have been bringing our dog here for almost 5 years and I can’t say enough good things about the people and experience. It’s run extremely well and the vets are caring, thoughtful and informative when it comes to our dog.
The Doctors and staff are wonderful!!!  It’s been a great experience every time.  Highly recommend.

Holt Vet is a superb veterinarian office. Their front desk is so helpful and easy to talk to regarding any questions. Dr. Harden is a superb veterinarian and communicator. We trusted her for surgical removal of a mass on our pup’s leg and everything turned out so well. She also diagnosed our pup’s underlying allergies - a cause of daily vomiting and awful ear infections (none of which has been present since switching food!!). Our pup is so special to our whole family and being able to have access to such a trusted vet is something we are very grateful for. Thank you!!!
My Tiger on the right  track to being able to see out off his left eye..he’s got a few days ahead w medicine.
It was great!
I’ve been taking my dogs here for years and am very happy with them!

My daughter’s standard poodle is her service dog. He was caughing and sounded like he was choking so I picked him up from her office and immediately brought him to Holt.

He is shy and scared at the vet so the staff allowed me to be in the examination room with him. Dr. Kiefer did a very thorough exam and diagnosed him with kennel cough. She answered all my questions and gave care instructions and prescribed 14 days of antibiotics for him to take.

My daughter and I are so grateful to  have Holt Veterinary Clinic as his vet. Everyone on the staff, from the receptionists to the vet techs to the vets are so kind and professional. My daughter’s service dog 🐩 is critically important to her ability to live an independent and productive life and we feel so blessed that he has the “gold standard” in veterinary care.

My senior dog gets all his issues addressed quickly,  efficiently and with loving care by all the doctors, techs and staff. We are extremely glad to have found Holt Veterinary Clinic. When we arrive the welcome we receive is like walking into a party. We will use Holt for all our veterinary needs.

Our dog is quite fearful at the vet office. They take time to get to know your pet’s personality. Unfortunately for our pet, he has to be medicated to get care, but we know that now & take the measures they recommend.
I highly recommend Holt Vet Clinic! I have taken my pets here for over 30 years and I always receive the best care for my pets. They are so kind, caring and professional.
I was very happy with Dr Watkins. She was personable & professional & helped my dog without expensive medication or surgery. I will definitely go back!
Very professional care and recommended a conservative care treatment plan that didn’t suggest unnecessary tests.
Fast & efficient highly recommend thanks 🙏 …

I am very happy I found Holt in my area after moving to Dallas. They are kind, I love the walk in policy, the have reasonable prices for my dog's care. I trust Dr. Bratton with my pup's care. He is direct, knowledgeable and is great with my baby.
I needed a Bordetelle vaccine for my dog. I took her in and they were able to immediately administer the vaccine. They were very pleasant and efficient.
Holt is friendly and professional. Our puppy doesn’t hate going to the vet and that is a relief for us.

The team at Holt is simply the best. They operate efficiently and conveniently. The  entire staff is trustworthy, kind,  and focused. Holt provides personal care and attention to detail.
Dr. Bratton and the entire staff of vets, techs, and admins are incredibly patient and compassionate. 5 stars for this phenomenal veterinary clinic.
Everyone is fabulous!  We are soo happy at Holt. Dr. Brattan is amazing
Simply the best!!! I’ve left lengthy reviews in the past praising the entire crew at Holt. But those three words sum it up, and they continue their high quality of service after all these years.
Been going here for almost two decades!  Love the staff!  They take care of all my fur babies!

Holt Vet is my #1 choice to board my two dogs! I know they will be in extraordinary hands as the staff, techs and veterinarians are all excellent and communicative of any needs or concerns. Highly recommend Holt Vet for your pets, it feels like a family when you walk in! ❤️
Just moved and my sweet girl needed a Vet. Stellar! They instilled caring, confidence and a solution. Fantastic.
Easy to walk in and see a vet. Staff is friendly as are the staff. Very efficient as well.

Always quick and treating my baby with care and patience. Shadow is a senior pup with anxiety, and the doctor and techs are always so kind and quick to get things done so she doesn’t have to stay scared for too long. Will always talk good and recommend Holt Vet Clinic!
We know are dogs are in good hands with holt. We always get straight answers and the Doctors and staff are top notch.

We have been using Holt Clinic for a few years
We have seen different for different dogs and have always been pleased. It’s nice to be able to drop in without appointments. I’ve never had to wait very long. I feel their fees are reasonable. They all seem to be big pet lovers.

Listened to my concerns and thoroughly examined my dog.   Advised me of their findings, options and recommendations.   After a day Dr Jenifer called to check on my pup who was greatly improved.
Highly recommend
The BEST vet team - so attentive, patient, and loving with my dogs. They always put us (humans and dogs alike) at ease. Love how clean and welcoming the office is.
Drs and Staff so wonderful!!!
Not 5 only because my dog is SUPER anxious about the vet. I know they use things for this… but yeah, he gets REALLY scared and cries. But the service is great. And the vets are super.
Holt vet is the best. Great staff and caring doctors are always there to help. I lost my first dog there and they all sent me a condolence card. Small acts of kindness make me a patient for life!
Great staff!
Always a pleasant experience
Great visit!  Dr Bratton is so awesome and super thorough!
Prompt service & very thorough.
Quick service, minimum time waiting.
I’ve always gotten called back extremely quickly and I’ve had a great experience with them everytime.
Great staff and short wait time!!
Molly has gone to Holt since she was a puppy and she is now 11.  We always get the best care and service!

I ADORE Holt Vet clinic. I have always had nervous rescue pups and it can be difficult to find vets who understand fear and respect the space and patience required for proper care. Every doc and tech at Holt takes their time to understand my nervous girl, treats her with kindness, works on her time and comfort level, and they do a wonderful job of listening  to my concerns and explaining everything to me in a way that makes sense. 10/10 would recommend!
Love this veterinary clinic.  Always great care for my pet and such friendly staff. Highly recommend!!

Urgent Concern Regarding Veterinary Care and Deceptive Practices of Holy

Please review all information carefully before choosing this clinic. Since the original owners left, the quality of care has significantly declined.

I waited two weeks for my dog’s X-rays, and despite his diagnosed bladder infection, the veterinarian refused to prescribe antibiotics. I paid $497 for X-rays, yet the images provided only showed his heart, not the trachea as requested. Additionally, false information was placed in his medical file.

Without my authorization, the clinic released my personal contact information to a third party and sent my dog’s records to a specialist before I had even arrived home. I was then pressured into scheduling a full cardiac workup.

The pet industry often preys on the emotions of pet parents because our pets cannot advocate for themselves. I urge everyone to conduct due diligence and take action against these predatory practices. I have filed complaints with the Texas Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners (TDLR) and the Texas Attorney General’s Office for deceptive trade practices regarding this organization.
Dr. Brent Salazar always makes our doggies feel safe while giving them the best care. I trust Holt Veterinary Clinic because of the great drs there like Dr Salazar❤️
Highly recommend! The friendliest staff that are amazing with my dog!
We are very pleased with the care our pets receive at Holt.

Every dog we've had has been under the care of Holt. They truly care about your pet and go over and beyond (personal experience) for their care and well being. Dr Bratton, in particular, is exceptional and I feel he exemplifies that experience with his staff. We will always entrust our pets care with them.

Unfortunately, I had to take my 11-year-old English Springer Spaniel, Abby, in for an emergency visit. We all know how unsettling it is when one of our furry companions is unwell.

Dr. Harden has been exceptional in caring for Abby. However, during my follow-up visit, the young woman who checked me in and out was extremely rude. Her behavior and lack of compassion only made an already uncomfortable situation worse.

I take my dog monthly for nail clipping and anal gland expression. We are always in and out in under 30 mins as a walk-in.

This past week, I asked to have the vet check my senior dog’s teeth as he had been exhibiting some sensitivity to crunchy food and had really bad breath for over a week.

Vet recommended a different dental chew (I have been giving my pup Greenies for ages and it suddenly wasn’t helping). Vet gave us a sample of six Oravet to try. My dog loves them (they are softer) so I ordered a monthly subscription from Holt’s website. Pretty close to the same price for a month’s worth of tough-to-chew Greenies. 10/10!
Extremely kind and helpful team who took great care of my new pup.

My wife and I just switched over to Holt and already had both our cats in to be checked over. We were both very pleased with the attention that our cats received. The doctors are knowledgeable and handled our pets well. The staff is as friendly as can be and our experience exceeded our expectations.
We love Holt Veterinary Clinic! All the doctors and staff are wonderful. Can’t recommend highly enough!

I can’t thank the staff at Holt enough. My dog was spayed this morning and the experience was flawless from start to finish. They were so kind and communicative throughout the entire process and she is recovering well.
Holt is amazing!
We have been going to Holt for more than 20 years because our dogs receive the best care. Highly recommended!
Everyone at Holt is wonderful. I would never take my Morkie anywhere else. I totally trust them.

We have used Holt for over 15 years. We had to put our sweet lab to sleep and they couldn’t have been kinder or more gentle. You don’t go into the “sterile checkup room” you go into a room w chairs and Kleenex and dimmed lights and once they get your fur baby prepped they bring them in w a blanket to cover them and give you alllll the time in the world to say goodbye. You can seriously sit in there all day they do not rush you. Once it is time they give them an injection and your baby goes to sleep. They then leave you again till you are ready to leave. At that point you go out of a side door instead of through the waiting room. They even send you a letter w your babies paw print stamped on it. If you choose to get your babies ashes back it is such a sweet box w their name. They are so kind through this process I won’t ever go anywhere else. Holts DrS and staff are very amazing and help through any issues you may have.

From the front desk, to the techs, and to the vets, everyone is super nice. For three generations of dogs, Holt Vet Clinic has been our primary care provider. If you’re looking for a vet, look no further. Shae and Pablo are the best.

Great service…HOWEVER…a little pricey.
Our pets are our babies…but COME ON!

The best place for your fur babies !!!
everyone is caring, understanding and truly empathetic

The doctors at Holt are amazing! We’ve been using them for over 15 years — with multiple dogs. They really care about helping you and your pet work and working through any health issue. I could not recommend them more.
I have been going to Holt for 25 years. LOVE them!

Love this place! I have a large super active dog who adores them. She can be hard to handle but they make it work and are always friendly about it. This happens from the patient, professional desk staff to the talented vets. I highly recommend. And she has had a difficult bacteria to treat and they have been all over it. Really appreciate Holt Vet!
Quick, efficient, immediate relief.

Dr. Bratton and his staff are skilled professionals that have honed their craft in a way that makes me feel so safe and cared for. His passion for the work is apparent in every interaction which is never rushed or hurried. Each concern is addressed with respect and I always leave feeling like it was money well spent. I became a believer when he saved one of my dogs lives with a diagnosis back in 2015 when several other vets in the area had absolutely no idea what was going on and basically said she was done. Molly went on to live 5 healthy more uears and I am forever grateful for his knowledge.

Our Finn needed relief from a gut issue. I called the office and got him in within the hour.
Friendly staff. Spot on diagnosis and treatment. Reasonable rates. We will definitely be back.

I’ve been going here for years to do my international paperwork.

I never had any problems with the paperwork. It’s always been excellent.
They are always responsive, knowlegeable, and friendly. They love our pets!
Absolute best vet experience in my life. Everyone at holt is so kind, patient, and caring. Cannot recommend holt enough

I have visited Holt Vet twice now. Once as a walk-in towards the end of the day and once as a scheduled Saturday visit. Both times were such a great experience.
